# AI speaker on a conference stage: a 9:16 keynote clip on Seedance 2.5

**One spoken line and a character prompt become an 8-second 9:16 clip of them on stage, with voice and applause.**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_2725d2895c21.webp" alt="A silver-haired man in a mustard-yellow suit and red sneakers delivers a line into a microphone on a spotlit keynote stage, then bows to the audience." width="480"></p>

Makes a vertical 9:16 "character on stage" video in one varg render: a custom character (Higgsfield Soul) stands at a conference keynote and delivers a one- or two-line hook with a physical punchline, voiced by Seedance 2.5 native audio with audience applause. Use when someone asks for a keynote or speaker-style UGC ad, a talking character or talking avatar giving a speech on stage, a spokesperson or mascot delivering one punchy line, a conference talk clip with a custom person, or wants to swap the character in this template. Not for long talking-head videos from a script or voiceover (use varg-ai with a lip-sync model), multi-scene ads with the same actors (use varg-consistent-characters), two-person dialogue (use varg-podcast-video), or songs (use varg-music-video).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill varg-character-keynote                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills varg-character-keynote --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 78 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Makes | 8 s 9:16 MP4 with voice |
| Needs | a varg account (OAuth through the varg MCP) or `VARG_API_KEY` |
| Typical cost | ~$3.50 per 8 s render at 720p (estimate) |
| Uses | varg API, Higgsfield Soul, Nano Banana 2.1, Seedance 2.5 |
| Works in | Claude Code, Codex, Grok, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Copilot, OpenCode and other Agent Skills tools |
| Agent instructions | [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) (v1.0.0) |

## Ask your agent

- "Make a 9:16 keynote clip of a 68-year-old woman on stage saying "I learned to code at sixty-eight""
- "Put our mascot on a conference stage delivering one punchy line, with applause at the end"
- "Swap the speaker in the keynote template for a big bearded chef and change the slide behind him to a pizza"
